mapper.sql: id, source, voucher_type, sign_company, business_date, voucher_date, currency, dept_name, voucher_summary, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, voucher_num, voucher_way, create_user_no, create_user_name, recheck_user_no, recheck_user_name, voucher_status,sub_scene_type
mapper.select:
select distinct ev.voucher_num from eg_voucher ev where 1=1
and CAST(ev.voucher_num AS text) like concat('%', #{param.searchKey}::text, '%')
and ev.period_code = #{param.periodCode}
order by ev.voucher_num asc

select eve.client_code from eg_voucher_entry eve left join eg_client ec on eve.client_code = ec.client_code and ec.del_flag = '0' where 1 = 1 and eve.del_flag = '0' and ec.client_name = #{clientName} order by eve.client_code limit 1

select ev.org_id, eoc.org_name , to_char(ev.business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') business_date, to_char(ev.voucher_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') voucher_date, ev.system_name, ev.scene_name, ev.contract_code, eve.account_code, eve.account_name, coalesce (eve.debit_amount, 0) debit_amount, coalesce(eve.credit_amount, 0) credit_amount , coalesce(eve.credit_amount, 0) - coalesce(eve.debit_amount, 0) as diff_amount from eg_voucher_entry eve inner join eg_voucher ev on eve.voucher_id = ev.id and ev.del_flag = '0' inner join eg_interface_data eid ON ev.interface_id = eid.interface_id and eid.del_flag ='0' left join eg_org_company eoc on eoc.org_id = ev.org_id and eoc.del_flag ='0' where eve.del_flag = '0' and ev.interface_data_id = #{param.interfaceId}
